bull.narrative: CRDO achieves significant market share gains, driven by successful product qualification with major cloud providers and a strong product roadmap, leading to revenue growth of 30% per annum and a market capitalization of $200B in 10 years.

base.narrative: CRDO executes on its product roadmap, qualifies with major cloud providers, and achieves steady revenue growth of 20% per annum, resulting in a market capitalization of $100B in 10 years.

bear.narrative: CRDO fails to qualify with major cloud providers, experiences significant delays in its product roadmap, and achieves limited revenue growth of 5% per annum, resulting in a market capitalization of $20B in 10 years.

tracking_note: CRDO has made significant progress in its product roadmap and is on track to qualify with major cloud providers.
thesis_breaks_if: failure to reach $1B in annual revenue within 5 years
